def diff_summary():
    prev = previous_frame.segmentation['nodes']; cur = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    def sig(nodes):
        d={}
        for n in nodes:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])

    out=[]
    for k in set(p)|set(c):

    return out

    print('B:', {k:res[k] for k in ('board_changed',)}, diff_summary())
if not diff_summary():
